challengesData.heading:
Common Pitfalls & 
 How We Plan for Them
challengesData.subhead: Most issues guests notice in an immersive room trace back to early design choices that are simpler to fix before buildout.

problem.title: Visible seams between projectors
problem.text: Overlapping projections create visible bright bands and color shifts where edges meet.

solution.title: Matched projectors with on-site edge blending
solution.text: We deploy identical projector models and calibrate color and blend zones on site.

problem.title: Images washed out by room light
problem.text: Uncontrolled ambient light washes out projections and makes dark tones look gray.

solution.title: Light readings before display selection
solution.text: Site light readings guide projector brightness, blackout blinds, or LED selection.
solution.tagline: Colors stay clear in room light

problem.title: Interaction lags or misfires
problem.text: Blind spots cause wall touches and floor steps to register late or in the wrong spot.

solution.title: Sensor coverage mapped to each surface
solution.text: We map sensor and camera zones on your plan and tune tracking with people of varied heights.

problem.title: Only the installer can change content
problem.text: Simple media updates require a technician visit, leaving displays outdated for months.

solution.title: Scene & playlist control for your team
solution.text: We install simple scheduling tools and train your team to swap media at handover.

problem.title: Heat, noise & dropouts
problem.text: Enclosed projectors and servers trap heat and fan noise, risking mid-show shutdowns.

solution.title: Heat load & power planned with your MEP team
solution.text: We calculate cooling and power loads early and house noisy racks outside the room.

problem.title: AV, content & IT blame each other
problem.text: When playback fails, each vendor blames another team's hardware or network setup.

solution.title: One contract covering AV, IT & content
solution.text: GS IT delivers the AV, network cabling, and content integration under one agreement.
solution.tagline: One point of contact for support

faqHeaderData.heading:
Common Questions on 
 Immersive Room AV

faqData.question: How long does an immersive room in Dubai take to build?
faqData.answer: Project timelines depend on surface count and hardware lead times for your immersive room in Dubai. Once we complete the site survey, you receive a dated project schedule mapping out each stage through completion.

faqData.question: Do you create the content for immersive room technology as well?
faqData.answer: Yes, our in-house team produces the visual media, custom software, and interactive applications tailored to your immersive room technology. When you already have a creative agency or internal team, we coordinate directly with them from the initial brief through final testing to verify smooth playback across all room surfaces.

faqData.question: What do you need from us before surveying immersive workspaces?
faqData.answer: Please share a floor plan showing ceiling heights, site photos, and the goals for your immersive workspaces. Knowing your target launch window and maximum visitor capacity also helps our engineers prepare accurate measurements and light tests during the initial site visit.

faqData.question: Projection or LED: which immersive display solutions suit our space?
faqData.answer: The right choice among immersive display solutions comes down to ambient light and viewing distance. Projection works well in dark spaces and across floors, while fine-pitch LED handles bright rooms and close viewing. Light readings taken at your survey guide the final mix for immersive and simulation display solutions.

faqData.question: What decides the hardware needed for an immersive video room?
faqData.answer: Surface dimensions and target image clarity determine the hardware specification for an immersive video room. Larger walls or detailed visuals require higher-lumen projectors or finer LED pixel pitches, which we finalize during design based on your site survey and content goals.

faqData.question: Can you add interaction or immersive virtual reality solutions?
faqData.answer: Yes, depth cameras and LiDAR sensors turn walls and floors into responsive touch or motion surfaces, and we also integrate immersive virtual reality solutions when a project calls for headsets. Our engineers map sensor coverage during design and fine-tune tracking accuracy on site with real visitors.

faqData.question: Do we need a technician to run an immersive meeting room?
faqData.answer: No, daily operation in an immersive meeting room needs no specialist technical skills. We program named presets that launch media, audio, and lighting from a single control tablet, enabling your sales or front-desk staff to host sessions confidently after brief handover training.

faqData.question: How often do immersive room projection solutions in Dubai need maintenance?
faqData.answer: Quarterly or biannual maintenance works best for immersive room projection solutions in Dubai. Even with long-lasting laser projectors, scheduled AMC visits help maintain image blends and color accuracy while catching hardware wear early.

faqData.question: Can our team update content in the immersive room ourselves?
faqData.answer: Yes, you can upload and schedule new media independently inside your immersive room. We configure an intuitive content management workflow and train your staff during handover, allowing your marketing or operations team to launch fresh campaigns without booking a support visit.

faqData.question: Can we expand our immersive room surfaces later?
faqData.answer: Yes, future expansion is straightforward when it is planned into the initial infrastructure design. Telling us early allows our engineers to size your media servers, power circuits, and cabling with spare capacity to add extra walls or floor projection later.
